title: Ivo and the Border
author: Yara Pemberton
blurb: Coral Oyelaran, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
